name: popintent
description: A local-first Chromium extension that blocks unexpected popup navigations.

scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm verify:dist && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package.ps1
scripts.package:beta: pnpm store:assets && pnpm build:beta && pnpm verify:beta && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-beta.ps1
scripts.package:diagnostic: pnpm build:diagnostic && pnpm verify:diagnostic && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-diagnostic.ps1
